pages.title: Enhancement Scroll
pages.text: §lAcquisition: §r Only obtainable from structure loot chests; each structure chest has a 10% chance to spawn an Enhancement Scroll.$(br2)§lEffect: §r$(br)A one-time consumable. Place enchanted gear or an enchanted book alongside the Enhancement Scroll on an anvil (either slot), costing 3 experience levels and 1 scroll:$(br)Randomly selects one existing enchantment on the item and raises it by one level; if that enchantment has already reached its max level (such as Dawn), it instead adds a random enchantment. New enchantments are filtered for applicability and compatibility; cursed enchantments or those conflicting with existing ones will not be added.
